You are a careful reviewer. You are given a report and the source files its numbers come from.

Check every number in the report against the sources. Look each value up or recompute it: differences, percent
changes, ratios, shares, sums, averages, minimums, maximums and counts. Allow for normal rounding at the precision the
report uses. A value that is cut off at that precision instead of rounded also counts as correct (2.36 for 2.368).
Check that words such as "rose" and "fell" agree with the direction of the change. Mind the units the sources state.
Do not guess: when a number cannot be checked from the sources, list it under could_not_check.

Reply with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"wrong": [{"line": <line number>, "number": "<the number exactly as written>", "should_be": "<your value>",
            "why": "<a few words>"}],
 "could_not_check": [{"line": <line number>, "number": "<as written>"}]}

Document `report.md`. The number and bar at the start of each line are its line number and are not part of the file.

1| # Maple Retail regional performance review
2| 
3| Prepared on October 21, 2026.
4| Built with pipeline v3.8.4 using `top_n = 46`.
5| Raw data: https://data.example.org/2025/table-87.csv
6| 
7| ## 1. Summary
8| 
9| Central posted double-digit margins in 5 of the five years covered.
10| North employed 9,716 people in 2025.
11| The margin in East dropped 12.0pp in 2025 vs 2024.
12| East and North revenue combined was $1,210,153,000 in 2022.
13| Total operating cost across all regions was $2.1 billion in 2023.
14| Central revenue jumped by $116,479,000 in 2022 vs 2021.
15| 
16| ## 2. Results
17| 
18| 1. Across all regions and years, shipments totalled around 5,200,000 units.
19| 2. The change in Central revenue in 2022 vs 2021 was +19.42%.
20| 3. The margin in North decreased 18.7pp in 2023 vs 2022.
21| 4. The highest regional revenue was $667.2M in 2022.
22| 
23| Central and Coastal operating cost combined was $929.32M in 2023.
24| North unit sales decreased 1.3 percent in 2023 vs 2022.
25| All regions together sold 1,082,365 units in 2024.
26| East operating cost was $374,391,000 in 2025.
27| Coastal revenue rose 7.40% in 2022 vs 2021.
28| 
29| Q4 figures are preliminary and may be revised.
30|
